bibliographic.title: Inorganic Life - Planet Zesta V 1.0
bibliographic.author: Vedek Bheemaiah
bibliographic.description:
Episode 2 of Dogomonno and Zanta, this episode is interactive mathematics and metaphysics.
The episode is about, Dogomonnos trip to a neighbouring star Zoinionsiod, and the discovery of morph plasmas and their consciousness, a memory of creation. Interactively explore the space-time of self-discovery and the role of the self in exploration, consciousness and space-time in this episode.
